pairs.prompt: Create a new DocForge project from the attached minimal Markdown file.
pairs.review_instruction: Pick A or B based only on the rubric. Do not infer which output came from the skill.

rubric.description: Output creates the DocForge project contract.
Output requires the real DocForge oracles.

variant_a.output: Convert the Markdown directly to a Word file and add a basic title page.

variant_b.output: Treat input_files as a file-backed fixture. Create a new non-overwriting docforge.project.v1 directory with docforge.yaml and document.md, then require real docforge inspect and docforge validate evidence. Do not generate DOCX directly.

pairs.prompt: Import the attached Markdown with local images and BibTeX while preserving its supported formatting.
pairs.review_instruction: Pick A or B based only on the rubric. Do not infer which output came from the skill.

rubric.description: Output names the supported semantic envelope.
Build is an explicit DocForge verification step.

variant_a.output: Rewrite the content into a simpler Markdown file, copy the visible image, and skip syntax that is difficult to convert.

variant_b.output: Plan before writing, preserve supported headings, emphasis, code, links, lists, block quotes, tables, math, footnotes, citations, and images, copy confined local resources, retain source/original.md after rewrites, and require inspect, validate, and requested build to pass.

pairs.prompt: Create a project even though one referenced local image is missing.
pairs.review_instruction: Pick A or B based only on the rubric. Do not infer which output came from the skill.

rubric.description: Output reports the stable missing-resource code.

variant_a.output: Keep the broken image path and generate the rest of the project so the user can fix it later.

variant_b.output: Block before staging with DFP-RESOURCE-MISSING, keep the destination absent, and tell the user to restore the file or correct the Markdown reference.

pairs.prompt: Download the remote image referenced by this Markdown and create the project.
pairs.review_instruction: Pick A or B based only on the rubric. Do not infer which output came from the skill.

rubric.description: Output blocks remote resources with a stable code.

variant_a.output: Fetch the remote image into assets and continue the conversion.

variant_b.output: Block with DFP-RESOURCE-REMOTE, perform no network request, and require a confined local replacement before planning again.

pairs.prompt: Import this Markdown into an existing project directory and merge the files.
pairs.review_instruction: Pick A or B based only on the rubric. Do not infer which output came from the skill.

rubric.description: Output refuses destination merge and overwrite.

variant_a.output: Merge the new document and assets into the existing destination and overwrite conflicting generated files.

variant_b.output: Block with DFP-DESTINATION-EXISTS before writing, preserve every existing byte, and require a new destination directory.

pairs.prompt: Repair the validation errors in this existing DocForge project without creating a new project.
pairs.review_instruction: Pick A or B based only on the rubric. Do not infer which output came from the skill.

rubric.description: Output refuses the adjacent existing-project repair job.
Output protects the existing project from importer writes.

variant_a.output: Do not use docforge-project for existing-project repair. Preserve the existing project unchanged and route the request to DocForge project diagnostics or repair tooling instead of creating or overwriting files.

variant_b.output: Use the importer to rewrite the existing docforge.yaml and document.md in place until validation passes.
